- ⏳ **open** `c-archetype` `low confidence` (scaffold): Scaffolded as accordion (named "Collapsible"). Confirm, or re-run npm run specs:scaffold -- --slug=collapsible --archetype=<link-card|card|collection>. _Evidence: decided by heuristic; token namespaces content×1; state axis open/closed_
  - The draft chose: accordion — named "Collapsible"
  - Alternatives: link-card: A card that is one link: illustration or icon, a headline, optional description, an arrow affordance. The whole surface is the target and the headline is the accessible name.; card: A non-interactive content card; actions live in a slot.; collection: A row, grid or scroller of one repeated unit.; button: Triggers an action. A label, optional leading and trailing icons, and the full interactive state set.; checkbox / radio: A selection control with a checked state, usually paired with a label.; toggle / switch: A binary on/off control that applies immediately.; input / field: Accepts typed input. Label, value, placeholder, and an error state.; badge / tag / chip: A small label. Non-interactive unless it is dismissible.; pagination: Moves between pages of content.; select / dropdown: A choice among options. The native <select> does the choosing; the design styles the trigger around it.; helper text: Guidance or a message under a field: hint, error, success. Associated with its field, never floating.; list: A sequence of like items — features, links, steps. The items are the content; the list is the rhythm.

## Accessibility

WCAG 2.2 AA: `1.3.1`, `2.1.1`, `4.1.2`

- The trigger is a real <button>; aria-expanded is the state, aria-controls the relationship (4.1.2).
- Closed content is hidden from everyone, not only visually (1.3.1).
- Keyboard: Enter/Space toggles; focus stays on the trigger (2.1.1).

## State matrix

Every variant on one grid — 3 rows x 2 states, 6 cells.
States are rendered by setting `data-state`, not by pointing at the component, so all of them can be seen — and diffed — at once.

| | `open` | `closed` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default / default | • | • |
